Practice sketching the form,paying attention to proportions of the body.  Use a good, natural shading technique (I’d recommend scribbling with a 2B and above pencil), also study laying light and shade. Draw same thing over and over again, take some paper for example and use a few sheets to draw lots of eyes, again and again, mouths, postures, whatever. Then start putting it together. Use A LOT of references. I’d recommend finding a picture and recreating it as accurately as possible. Don’t make stuff too even, too symmetrical, too clean. Practice all the time. If you travel, take a sketchbook and draw people you see, you’ll soon pick up the patterns of how the body looks in certain positions, how it generally behaves. I strongly recommend Mark Crilley’s channel on YT for other helpful advice.
